verdict.rationale: Stable's AI features are AI document summaries and an 'AI-powered inbox' that sorts and routes mail automatically. Neither lets a user operate the product by issuing natural-language commands. The llms.txt file and REST API are machine-readable building blocks, not a natural-language command interface, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
